svg.title: Sidira — horizontal lockup
svg.desc: Primary horizontal lockup: six-blade diaphragm + SIDIRA narrow uppercase. Mark height = wordmark cap-height × 1.25. Mark-to-wordmark gap = mark width × 0.28. Stroke and text both use currentColor; consumer controls the ink. Production font: Söhne Schmal Halbfett. Preview fallback: Archivo Narrow SemiBold.

text.font-family: 'Söhne Schmal Halbfett', 'Archivo Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif
